correctness.rationale: In characteristic zero the 11 Hom-trialgebra identities reduce the universal Hom-associator to -a(b+c) A+b(a+c) C+c(a-b) E, establishing sufficiency of all three polynomial conditions. Necessity follows from the valid 2-dimensional TH_2^7 algebra: the ordered triples (e2,e2,e1), (e1,e2,e2), (e1,e2,e1) yield a(b+c), -b(a+c), c(a-b) separately. The joint zero locus is precisely the three coordinate axes and the signed line (1,1,-1). The all-plus associator on (e1,e2,e2) is -2e1, so the source's Proposition 2.6 is false in characteristic zero. Independent exact symbolic reconstruction verified witness identities, 8 basis triples, all three isolators, and the signed product; the full universal normal-form step was inspected in the frozen verifier and source identities, not inferred from numerical tests.
